description: Crypto pairs / statistical arbitrage. BTC/ETH H1 joint data (50k bars 2020-2026, return corr 0.83). Market-neutral spread trading — structurally different from all directional mechanisms (A-J all failed).
notes: Opened 2026-08-06 after Direction J stopped (3 consecutive REJECTS).
Market-neutral (long/short spread) — survives regimes; H1 frequency avoids COT-style underpoweredness.
Costs: Binance taker 10 bps rt + slippage 2 bps/leg = ~14 bps rt per pair trade.

hypotheses.name: BTC/ETH Pairs Trading (log-ratio z-score + Engle-Granger)
hypotheses.hypothesis: Log-price-ratio mean reversion between BTC and ETH (corr 0.83) produces net profit after 14 bps rt costs.
hypotheses.mechanism: Statistical arbitrage: long ratio when z <= -2, short when z >= +2, exit |z| <= 0.5. Arms: log-ratio z-score (pairs_mr), Engle-Granger (pgm_pairs).
hypotheses.cost_basis: Binance taker 10 bps rt + slippage 2 bps/leg (~14 bps rt/pair)
hypotheses.validation_plan: compute_pairs_mr_signal + compute_pgm_pairs_signals on joint H1; pooled DK t + Sharpe gates; min trades >= 100.
